paper_metadata.title: Achieving high-performance pure tungsten by additive manufacturing: Processing, microstructural evolution and mechanical properties
paper_metadata.journal: International Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials

evidence.quote: Achieving high-performance pure tungsten by additive manufacturing: Processing, microstructural evolution and mechanical properties
In this work, tungsten nanopowder was innovatively used in indirect additive manufacturing (PEP) and successfully manufactured pure tungsten green parts.
pure tungsten green parts were successfully manufactured by indirect additive manufacturing technology, powder extrusion printing.
